name: ghg_base_year_recalculation_pathway_gap
question_template: A company's GHG inventory reports base-year Scope 1 plus Scope 2 emissions E0={BASE_EMISSIONS} tons CO2e. During the reporting period it acquired a business whose base-year emissions were A={ACQUIRED_EMISSIONS} tons CO2e; the current-year inventory already includes the acquired business. Base-year recalculation policy: if A divided by E0 is at least the significance threshold s={THRESHOLD_PCT} percent (exactly at the threshold triggers recalculation), the base year is recalculated to E0 plus A; otherwise the base year stays E0. The company's target is to cut emissions by R={TARGET_REDUCTION_PCT} percent below the (possibly recalculated) base-year emissions by the target year, N={HORIZON_YEARS} years after the base year, following a straight-line pathway from base-year emissions to the target-year level. The current reporting year is k={YEARS_ELAPSED} years after the base year, with reported emissions C={CURRENT_EMISSIONS} tons CO2e. Excess over pathway is current emissions minus the pathway allowance for year k, positive when above the pathway. Compute the constant annual percentage reduction that, applied to C and compounding each year over the remaining N minus k years, lands exactly on the target-year level. Use exact arithmetic for all tonnage quantities and round only the final percentage half up to two decimal places.

slots.description: Whether the recalculation policy is triggered.
Exact base-year emissions after policy applied.
Exact straight-line pathway allowance for current year.
Exact signed current emissions above pathway allowance.

program:
def solve():
    E0 = P["BASE_EMISSIONS"]
    A = P["ACQUIRED_EMISSIONS"]
    s = P["THRESHOLD_PCT"]
    R = P["TARGET_REDUCTION_PCT"]
    N = P["HORIZON_YEARS"]
    k = P["YEARS_ELAPSED"]
    C = P["CURRENT_EMISSIONS"]
    share = Fraction(A, E0)
    recalc = share >= Fraction(s) / 100
    base = E0 + A if recalc else E0
    target_level = base * (1 - Fraction(R) / 100)
    allowance = base - (base - target_level) * Fraction(k, N)
    excess = C - allowance
    remaining = N - k
    if remaining < 1:
        raise ValueError("no remaining years")
    if C <= target_level:
        raise ValueError("current emissions already at or below target level")
    if C > base:
        raise ValueError("current emissions exceed base-year emissions")
    ratio = Fraction(target_level) / C
    rate = 100 * (1 - exp(ln(ratio) / remaining))
    return {
        "final": rate,
        "base_year_recalculated": "true" if recalc else "false",
        "adjusted_base_year_emissions": base,
        "current_year_pathway_allowance": allowance,
        "excess_over_pathway": excess,
    }
